title: RISE Live: a fast reading on any OpenRouter model the reader names, free ones included
acceptance: Under OpenRouter in the venue's 'Who answers', a Model field names the model asked (placeholder the default, anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5); typed, it is the next request's model at once; it is kept as the liveOpenRouterModel setting across a reload; empty asks the default; no other provider shows it.

OpenRouter is asked with reasoning off (reasoning.effort none). A model that must reason refuses that with a 400 naming reasoning and is asked exactly once more without the field; any other refusal is asked once.
OpenRouter's 404 (a known model with no provider answering) is said as unavailable, never as 'no model called' that name; a 400 naming the model still says it has none by that name.
A free NVIDIA model (nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free) gives a complete reading in a few seconds through RISE's own adapter and parser.

evidence.note: Branch live-openrouter-models, PR #741, run on revision 5fa6dd13. npx vitest run src/live/host/venue.test.js src/app.safety.test.js src/live/adapters: 31 files, 686 passed, 4 skipped; one app.safety test (the recursive service-locator scan) timed out under that load and passes alone (26 of 26).

Agent observation, not a human's: real OpenRouter requests on the owner's key from a local script, through RISE's own adapter and stream parser, $0. Before: nemotron-3.5-lightning:free took 23 to 54 s and 2,000 to 4,096 tokens a reading, one ending with no words. After (this branch): 1.4 to 1.9 s, 68 to 134 tokens, three of three complete with no refusal. nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free answered 404 'Provider returned error' while its only endpoint showed status -5. Lightning wrote unusable @scene lines in two of three readings (dropped by the parser): a follow-up.

Fresh release-closure reconciliation: PR #741 merged at 7590a390cb7a49c005df380637b1c2355a1efbfd, included in main ec53f05f59f285a8fa7f193a2dbfc942fb37190e. This supersedes earlier branch-only delivery notes; owner, status and acceptance criteria are preserved.

Production job succeeded and verified the exact ec53f05 release; the separate private voice-provider job failed assets-upload-session access. The red overall workflow is not evidence of a public outage. Full validation run 40414014363 succeeded.

Agent HTTP observation during release closure: 200 and body ec53f05f59f285a8fa7f193a2dbfc942fb37190e. This confirms the release marker, not feature acceptance, real-model output, an actual phone or a human approval.

activity.summary: Created after the owner asked for free real inference (NVIDIA's own API refuses this site's origin, LIVE-031); built on branch live-openrouter-models. Not merged, not deployed, not accepted by a human.
Reconciled obsolete branch delivery against exact merged history and verified ec53f05 release; preserved owner/status/acceptance and kept model/device/human gates separate.

summary: Any OpenRouter model by name in the Live venue, free NVIDIA Nemotron included, asked with reasoning off so a reading takes seconds, and an honest word when a model's provider is down.
